violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Exclusion Criteria (26 TAC §746.501(a)(3))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation failed to follow their Illness and Exclusion policy for children with a fever and allowed a child to remain in care.

finding_variants.text: The operation failed to follow their Illness and Exclusion policy for children with a fever and allowed a child to remain in care.

Based on information gathered during the course of the investigation, it is determined that the operation has allowed children with a fever to remain in care. When children are sent home with a fever, they are not required to remain out of care until 24 hours symptom-free.
The operational policy book did not include how the operation supports children with special needs.
